rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: At the first sitting of the National Assembly after the 2014 election, with Chief Justice Mogoeng Thomas Reetsang Mogoeng presiding under section 86(2), Jacob Gedleyihlekisa Zuma was the only nominee and, 'There being no further nominations', the Chief Justice declared him duly elected President of the Republic of South Africa.

Election, oath, inauguration, resignation announcement, resignation effect and acting service stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row.
